Aeroflex Enterprises is a diversified business and investment platform combining enterprise building with strategic investing. Its businesses span knowledge-driven engineering and advanced manufacturing, industrial and utility services, financial services, packaging, strategic investments, and startup ventures. Through its subsidiaries and step-down subsidiaries, AEL builds, scales, and invests in businesses across multiple sectors, balancing established, cash-generating operations with high-growth ventures. With a growing international footprint across the Middle East, Europe, Asia, Africa, and the Americas.
